name: Rona
description: Rona is a Tolarian academy acolyte with a mechanical eye who became a Phyrexian aide to Sheoldred.

description_citations.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

bio.text: Rona attacked Karn with a glaive, and though Karn defeated her and broke her mechanical eye, he refused to kill her.

timeline.summary: An acolyte raises an alarm, the Phyrexians begin evacuating, and Rona attacks Karn with a glaive.
timeline.quote: The shrill sound prompted action.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn defeats Rona, breaking her mechanical eye, but refuses to kill her, saying he is not a weapon.
timeline.quote: "I am not a weapon."

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: As Karn plants an incendiary device inside Sheoldred, Rona's magic paralyzes him.
timeline.quote: But his hand did not move.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Rona tells Karn the forces have evacuated to secondary staging areas, and Sheoldred splits into spider-like pieces that scatter over him.
timeline.quote: Sheoldred split apart, dividing herself up in pieces.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Rona taunts Karn about Memnarch and collapses the cavern onto him.
timeline.quote: Tons of rock poured onto him.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian dragon engine driven by Rona attacks Yavimaya, uprooting the Magnigoths.
timeline.quote: a dragon engine reared into Yavimaya's vacant blue skies.

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Meria finds a Thran artifact in the mud; Jodah portals them away and it creates a vacuum that kills the dragon engine's organic parts.
timeline.quote: The Thran weapon had created a spherical vacuum.

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Rona flees from the dragon engine, and Meria decides her people must fight.
timeline.quote: "Then there's only one path for us. And it doesn't lie in Yavimaya."

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret enters Shiv's cave complex and brutally forces Rona to give a status report.
timeline.quote: I've been told that unprotected flesh takes a few seconds to vaporize in the Blind Eternities.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Rona reports the Phyrexians' losses and that the Planeswalkers have been tracked to New Argive.
timeline.quote: But we have been able to track them back to New Argive.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Rona appears, blasts Elspeth and Jodah with lightning, and stabs Jodah in the gut as revenge for Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: This is for the trouble you caused me in Yavimaya,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth wounds Rona with her sword, though her arm is run through by the glaive.
timeline.quote: burying her sword deep into Rona's shoulder.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret arrives, spares Elspeth, tells her to disappear before the tower falls, and carries off Rona.
timeline.quote: I suggest you take this opportunity to find somewhere remote and disappear.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret arrives at the Fair Basilica through the Planar Bridge carrying Rona's remains and demands to see Elesh Norn.
timeline.quote: I must see Mother,

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn summons Tezzeret and orders Rona's remains sent to Jin-Gitaxias.
timeline.quote: Send the other to Jin-Gitaxias for reconditioning.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret blames his failure on Rona and Sheoldred's treachery, and Norn accepts it.
timeline.quote: We were routed when our own troops turned on us.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Rona seriously wounds Jodah at Urza's Tower and is wounded by Elspeth.
timeline.quote: However, she was wounded by Elspeth Tirel in return, and Tezzeret spirited her away.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Second Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rona pilots a dragon engine and Sheoldred affixes her torso to one during the Second Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Sheoldred affixed her humanoid torso to a dragon engine for the Battle of the Mana Rig

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Dragon engines". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah gives Teferi, Saheeli and Kaya Urza's time machine blueprints and is grievously wounded defending the tower from Rona's forces.
timeline.quote: he was grievously wounded while helping protect the tower from Rona 's forces

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Caves of Koilos Karn finds Sheoldred's staging ground and Rona collapses the cavern on him.
timeline.quote: Rona collapsed the cavern on Karn, incapacitating the golem

citation.text: "Karn", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rona and Sheoldred stage the second invasion in the caves; Karn confronts Rona and buries him under rock.
timeline.quote: Rona was confronted by Karn, who managed to bury him under tons of rock.

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Second Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Norn tasks the newly compleated Rona with invading Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn tasked the newly compleat Rona with the invasion of Dominaria

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Burnt out, Tezzeret is granted a darksteel body by Elesh Norn and the Planar Bridge is removed; its fate is unknown.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn granted him the darksteel body

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "Phyrexia: All Will Be One". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred allies with the Society of Mishra, Rona and a resurrected Ertai, raising an army of compleated Argivians and sleeper agents.
timeline.quote: The invasion began when Sheoldred , the Whispering One, allied with the Society of Mishra

citation.text: "Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rona assaults Urza's Tower, wounds Jodah, and is struck down by Elspeth; Tezzeret extracts her.
timeline.quote: Rona severely wounded Jodah with her glaive before being struck down by Elspeth Tirel

citation.text: "Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred arrives in the Caves of Koilos on Dominaria, recuperates, and is rebuilt by Rona and the Society of Mishra.
timeline.quote: was discovered and rebuilt by Rona and the Society of Mishra

citation.text: "Sheoldred", section "On Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret retrieves a defeated Rona at Urza's Tower rather than executing wounded planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret merely retrieved a defeated Rona and delivered a warning

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: They fight and she buries him.
relations.quote: "Your mistake," she said, "was not killing me when you had the chance.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

relations.quote: Tezzeret rejoined the Phyrexian cause and aided Rona's assault on Urza's Tower

citation.text: "Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
